sql: SELECT MAX(o.VALUE) FROM patients p JOIN observations o ON p.patient = o.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND o.DESCRIPTION = 'Systolic Blood Pressure'
SELECT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN observations o ON p.patient = o.PATIENT WHERE o.DESCRIPTION = 'Systolic Blood Pressure' ORDER BY o.VALUE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT m.REASONDESCRIPTION FROM patients p JOIN medications m ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND m.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Acetaminophen%'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN medications m ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE m.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Acetaminophen%'

SELECT o.VALUE, o.UNITS FROM patients p JOIN observations o ON p.patient = o.PATIENT WHERE p.prefix = 'Mr.' AND p.first = 'Vincent' AND p.last = 'Wyman' AND o.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height' AND o.DATE = '2010-08-02'
SELECT DISTINCT a."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" FROM conditions c JOIN all_prevalences a ON lower(a.ITEM) = lower(c.DESCRIPTION) WHERE c.CODE = '64859006'
SELECT COUNT(a.PATIENT) FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON p.patient = a.PATIENT WHERE p.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND p.first = 'Saundra' AND p.last = 'Monahan'
SELECT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN claims c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE c.BILLABLEPERIOD = '1947-09-11'
SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION FROM patients p JOIN conditions c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Keven' AND p.last = 'Kuhn' AND c.START = '2016-09-24' AND c.STOP = '2016-10-10'
SELECT pr.DATE FROM patients p JOIN procedures pr ON p.patient = pr.PATIENT WHERE p.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND p.first = 'Ira' AND p.last = 'Deckow' AND pr.DESCRIPTION = 'Standard pregnancy test'
SELECT PATIENT FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension' ORDER BY START DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM allergies GROUP BY DESCRIPTION ORDER BY COUNT(DESCRIPTION) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.PATIENT) FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE m.DESCRIPTION = 'Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral Tablet' AND m.START LIKE '2016%' AND p.ethnicity = 'dominican' AND strftime('%m', m.STOP) - strftime('%m', m.START) = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM patients p JOIN immunizations i ON p.patient = i.PATIENT WHERE p.race = 'black' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'DTaP' AND i.DATE LIKE '2013%'
SELECT DISTINCT c.PATIENT FROM conditions c JOIN all_prevalences a ON lower(a.ITEM) = lower(c.DESCRIPTION) WHERE a."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" = 18.8
SELECT COUNT(c.DESCRIPTION) FROM patients p JOIN conditions c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Tyree' AND p.last = 'Eichmann'

SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y', p.deathdate) - strftime('%Y', p.birthdate) FROM patients p JOIN conditions c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Giovanni' AND p.last = 'Russel' AND c.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM patients p JOIN medications m ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.race = 'asian' AND p.gender = 'F' AND m.DESCRIPTION = 'oxaliplatin 5 MG/ML [Eloxatin]'
SELECT AVG(o.VALUE) FROM observations o WHERE o.DESCRIPTION = 'Diastolic Blood Pressure' AND o.PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension')
